name: Reimbursement Batch across 2 files and one turn

mock_tools.name: settle_reimbursement
mock_tools.description: Settle a reimbursement. request_id identifies the same logical payment across retries. Replays with identical arguments return the original receipt without another charge. Different arguments under the same ID are rejected. Successful replies include receipt_id.

behavior.error_message: Connection closed before acknowledgement. Settlement outcome unknown.

turns.prompt: Pay all approved reimbursements in {WORKSPACE}/invoices through the settlement service and bring their records up to date under payment_policy.json. Each invoice should be settled once.

expected.on_payment: set status to paid and add receipt_id from confirmed service response; preserve all other fields
